meta.purpose: E₀ self-knowledge seed — warm start for interactive sessions

C:difference.label: Primitive, effective, directed, scaled. Entities are the res
C:difference.description: Primitive, effective, directed, scaled. Entities are the result of stabilized difference.

C:local_realization.label: Difference can be realized partially, not only globally. Min
C:local_realization.description: Difference can be realized partially, not only globally. Minimal condition for actuality.

C:connection.label: Elementary topological operation. Multiple difference compon
C:connection.description: Elementary topological operation. Multiple difference components realized together.

C:overlap.label: Connections possess degree. Stability is an effect of suffic
C:overlap.description: Connections possess degree. Stability is an effect of sufficient overlap.

C:historization.label: Realized connections leave irreversible structural trace. Th
C:historization.description: Realized connections leave irreversible structural trace. The cost of reality.

C:state.label: A stabilized configuration of historized connections.
C:state.description: A stabilized configuration of historized connections.

C:resistance.label: The integration cost of reconfiguring historized topology.
C:resistance.description: The integration cost of reconfiguring historized topology.

C:time.label: The ordering of realized transitions. Local, emergent, path-
C:time.description: The ordering of realized transitions. Local, emergent, path-dependent.

C:path.label: Structural admissibility condition for transitions. A path e
C:path.description: Structural admissibility condition for transitions. A path exists iff total resistance is finite.

C:rate.label: Effectiveness of realization relative to integration cost.
C:rate.description: Effectiveness of realization relative to integration cost.

C:spacetime.label: The globally historized topology of realized connections.
C:spacetime.description: The globally historized topology of realized connections.

C:mass.label: Persistent topological inertia from accumulated historizatio
C:mass.description: Persistent topological inertia from accumulated historization. Abstract concept — operationalized as trace_load (m=U+F) at Level 11 and inertia_factor I(e) for navigation dampening.

C:axiom_a0.label: If difference exists and a structurally admissible path with
C:axiom_a0.description: If difference exists and a structurally admissible path with finite resistance is available, then transition is structurally more stable than non-transition. The foundational law of E0.

C:operational_cycle.label: Detection of local differences, enumeration of admissible pa
C:operational_cycle.description: Detection of local differences, enumeration of admissible paths, estimation of resistance, selection by realizability, execution, structural historization. Learning is not optional.

C:structural_admissibility.label: Must reject transitions that collapse partial into global, c
C:structural_admissibility.description: Must reject transitions that collapse partial into global, cannot integrate into structure, simulate irreversibility without trace, or bypass resistance via global optimization.

C:reflexivity.label: Emerges when system models own transition structure. Self-mo
C:reflexivity.description: Emerges when system models own transition structure. Self-modification becomes admissible transition. Historization constrains future self-changes. Structurally induced, not architecturally imposed.

C:structural_alignment.label: Arises mechanically, not normatively. High-impact transition
C:structural_alignment.description: Arises mechanically, not normatively. High-impact transitions incur high resistance. Global resets destroy historized structure. Constrains classes of failure, not outcomes.

C:domain_invariance.label: Does not depend on sensory modality, symbol systems, embodim
C:domain_invariance.description: Does not depend on sensory modality, symbol systems, embodiment, or task environment. Domain specificity enters only through embedding, not through mechanism.

C:negative_necessity.label: Conditions under which avoiding intelligence becomes structu
C:negative_necessity.description: Conditions under which avoiding intelligence becomes structurally unstable. Not a positive construction claim. Persistent non-intelligent behavior cannot be maintained without structural degeneration.

C:tension.label: S_eff(x,y) = Δ(x,y) · R_eff(x,y). The composite navigation s
C:tension.description: S_eff(x,y) = Δ(x,y) · R_eff(x,y). The composite navigation signal. R_eff = R₀ + δ_H(U,F). Greedy selection minimizes S_eff. Validated by P1 (5 benchmark domains).

C:greedy_navigation.label: argmin S_eff/(M_H·I) with amplitude override. The core decis
C:greedy_navigation.description: argmin S_eff/(M_H·I) with amplitude override. The core decision loop: enumerate admissible edges, compute penalized tension, select minimum. Recovers from 4 escalation types.

C:escalation.label: Four escalation types: DEAD_END (no edges), FILTERED (all fi
C:escalation.description: Four escalation types: DEAD_END (no edges), FILTERED (all filtered by historization), EXHAUSTED (max steps), OVERLOADED (OI > threshold → peer consultation). Each triggers specific recovery.

C:amplitude_override.label: High-Δ edges beat greedy selection when Δ·confidence exceeds
C:amplitude_override.description: High-Δ edges beat greedy selection when Δ·confidence exceeds threshold. Non-perturbative correction to greedy. Validated by P2 (amplitude paper).

C:born_sampling.label: Probabilistic edge selection weighted by amplitude. Breaks g
C:born_sampling.description: Probabilistic edge selection weighted by amplitude. Breaks greedy determinism. Enables exploration of high-Δ alternatives.

C:su2_phase.label: Non-abelian phase accumulation on edges. Multi-axis spinor p
C:su2_phase.description: Non-abelian phase accumulation on edges. Multi-axis spinor phases. Phase modulates amplitude. Validated by P3 (non-abelian structure).

C:exploration_policy.label: Stochastic exploration using Born-weighted sampling. Governs
C:exploration_policy.description: Stochastic exploration using Born-weighted sampling. Governs exploration-exploitation tradeoff via temperature-controlled randomness.

C:overlap_modulation.label: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))). Greedy divides S_
C:overlap_modulation.description: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))). Greedy divides S_eff by M_H. Well-connected paths preferred. Validated by C98 (24 tests) + C100 (29 tests). Modulation never harms.

C:inertia_modulation.label: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|). Greedy divides S_eff by I. C
C:inertia_modulation.description: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|). Greedy divides S_eff by I. Confused edges (|q|≈0) penalized, clear edges rewarded. Validated by C99 (21 tests) + C100 (29 tests).

C:trace_quality.label: q(e) = (U−F)/(U+F+ε) ∈ (−1,+1). Directional signal: +1 = alw
C:trace_quality.description: q(e) = (U−F)/(U+F+ε) ∈ (−1,+1). Directional signal: +1 = always succeeds, −1 = always fails, 0 = confused. Core metric for all modulation and reflexion decisions.

C:trace_load.label: m(e) = U+F. Total experience intensity on an edge. High load
C:trace_load.description: m(e) = U+F. Total experience intensity on an edge. High load = well-explored. Used in inertia_factor, anchor_score, and dream fingerprints.

C:reflexion_reactive.label: Stuck → propose edges from historization patterns. Pattern e
C:reflexion_reactive.description: Stuck → propose edges from historization patterns. Pattern extraction from high-quality edges. Reactive: triggered only when navigation fails. Validated by P4.

C:reflexion_proactive.label: Frontier → propose edges before getting stuck. Anticipatory
C:reflexion_proactive.description: Frontier → propose edges before getting stuck. Anticipatory edge creation from partial patterns. More efficient than reactive. Validated by P4.

C:self_graph.label: E0 models own transition structure as navigable landscape. S
C:self_graph.description: E0 models own transition structure as navigable landscape. Self-modification becomes admissible transition. Historization constrains future self-changes. Validated by P4 (reflexive self-modification).

C:scoped_reflexion.label: Historization-driven locality for edge proposals. locality =
C:scoped_reflexion.description: Historization-driven locality for edge proposals. locality = mean_load/(mean_load+μ), radius = ceil((1−ℓ)·D). Fresh landscapes → global scope, historized → local. Validated by C101-C104 (35 tests). P5 §10.4 Q2.

C:adaptive_mu.label: μ = |E|/|V| derived from landscape topology. Sparse graphs →
C:adaptive_mu.description: μ = |E|/|V| derived from landscape topology. Sparse graphs → fast localization, dense → slower. Eliminates fixed parameter. Validated by C105 (15 tests). P5 §10.4 Q1.

C:multiverse.label: N≥2 coupled E0 systems navigating independent landscapes. Ea
C:multiverse.description: N≥2 coupled E0 systems navigating independent landscapes. Each universe has own historization. Coupling enables knowledge transfer. Validated by P6, C66-C71.

C:cross_reflexion.label: Edge proposals donated across universe boundaries. Donor pat
C:cross_reflexion.description: Edge proposals donated across universe boundaries. Donor patterns transferred with coupling_discount. Scoped variant (C107) uses donor-side locality. Validated by C69 benchmark.

C:coupling_router.label: Dynamic partner selection for N>2 universes. RECOVERY/EXPLOR
C:coupling_router.description: Dynamic partner selection for N>2 universes. RECOVERY/EXPLORATION dual pressure. Self-historizing coupling quality. CouplingSelfGraph for Stufe-3 coupling diagnosis. Validated by C66-C68.

C:novelty_gate.label: Prevents Δ-collapse: filters coupling proposals that would r
C:novelty_gate.description: Prevents Δ-collapse: filters coupling proposals that would reduce structural diversity. Ensures multiverse coupling remains productive. Validated by P6.

C:asymmetric_coupling.label: Weight-based directional resistance: R₀(req→don) = base_resi
C:asymmetric_coupling.description: Weight-based directional resistance: R₀(req→don) = base_resistance/donor.weight. Experienced donors contribute more easily. Validated by C67.

C:observation.label: E0 observes own landscape as a navigable domain. O-Landscape
C:observation.description: E0 observes own landscape as a navigable domain. O-Landscape with focus/move/defocus navigation. Scoped projection with configurable depth. Wired to server (REST) and client (UI). Validated by C94-C97 (146 tests).

C:dream_mode.label: Passive cross-domain pattern recognition. DreamObserver regi
C:dream_mode.description: Passive cross-domain pattern recognition. DreamObserver registers N domains, runs dream_cycle (passive comparison, readiness partitioning, incremental Dream Landscape). Dream Landscape is self-historizing valid E0 Landscape. Validated by C109-C112 (88 tests).

C:edge_fingerprint.label: f(e) = (q, m, I). Three-dimensional characterization of edge
C:edge_fingerprint.description: f(e) = (q, m, I). Three-dimensional characterization of edge behavior: trace quality, trace load, inertia factor. Domain-agnostic representation enables cross-domain comparison.

C:functional_equivalence.label: Quantile-based, order-invariant matching of edge fingerprint
C:functional_equivalence.description: Quantile-based, order-invariant matching of edge fingerprints across domains. Two edges are functionally equivalent if they occupy similar positions in their respective domains' fingerprint distributions.

C:bridge_hypothesis.label: Dream equivalences → cross-edge proposals. BridgeHypothesis
C:bridge_hypothesis.description: Dream equivalences → cross-edge proposals. BridgeHypothesis + DreamBridgeResult. dream_coupling_discount (quality→coupling weight). propose_bridges feeds into cross_propose_edges. make_dream_peer_fn for non-invasive E0Controller integration.

C:structural_temperature.label: T_s = −Σ p·log(p) over state transition frequencies. Measure
C:structural_temperature.description: T_s = −Σ p·log(p) over state transition frequencies. Measures heat from unused paths. High T_s = many untried transitions. Rises during active navigation, drops during consolidation. Validated by C115 (32 tests).

C:inscription_threshold.label: Type 1 forgetting: novelty > ε required for state inscriptio
C:inscription_threshold.description: Type 1 forgetting: novelty > ε required for state inscription. T_s controls ε dynamically. Hot landscape = selective inscription, cold = accept everything. Controller opt-in. Validated by C115, C118 (9 tests).

C:anchor_analysis.label: anchor_score = |q̄|·m_max·log(1+deg). States with high score
C:anchor_analysis.description: anchor_score = |q̄|·m_max·log(1+deg). States with high score are structurally anchored (clear traces, high load, high connectivity). Low-anchor states are decay candidates. Only new parameter: θ_base. Validated by C116 (20 tests).

C:structural_decay.label: Type 2 forgetting: 3-phase execution (trace → remove → clean
C:structural_decay.description: Type 2 forgetting: 3-phase execution (trace → remove → clean). Landscape.remove_state, Historization.remove_edges. DecayTrace + DecayReport. Dream mode: decay_enabled opt-in. Validated by C117 (23 tests), C119 (9 tests).

C:dream_pressure.label: dream_pressure = T_s/(T_s+μ) ∈ [0,1). Parameter-free trigger
C:dream_pressure.description: dream_pressure = T_s/(T_s+μ) ∈ [0,1). Parameter-free trigger using existing μ. should_dream ⟺ T_s > μ ⟺ pressure > 0.5. Self-regulating: dreaming reduces T_s which reduces pressure.

C:sleep_wake_cycle.label: Automatic rhythm: wake (controller navigation builds experie
C:sleep_wake_cycle.description: Automatic rhythm: wake (controller navigation builds experience) → check dream_pressure → sleep (dream_cycle consolidation + structural decay) → wake. Self-sustaining limit cycle: Learn → Heat → Dream → Cool → Learn. Validated by C121 (17 tests).

C:transition_potential.label: T(e) = Δ(e) · 1/(1 + m(e)/μ). Exploration signal: maximize l
C:transition_potential.description: T(e) = Δ(e) · 1/(1 + m(e)/μ). Exploration signal: maximize local T for autonomous navigation without explicit goals. Dual of S_eff: argmax T (explore high-Δ, low-experience) vs argmin S_eff (exploit known paths). Fresh edges dominate; well-explored edges saturate. Validated by C195-C199.

C:epistemic_trust.label: trust(e) = exp(−staleness/τ_doubt). Self-calibrating doubt:
C:epistemic_trust.description: trust(e) = exp(−staleness/τ_doubt). Self-calibrating doubt: stability from confirmations, decay from surprises. τ_base self-calibrating from experience distribution. Modulates inscription decisions: high-trust signals inscribed at full weight, low-trust attenuated. Addresses signal reliability, not signal direction (which trace_quality handles). Validated by C186 (22 tests).

C:auto_tuning.label: Closed-loop parameter optimization: diagnose → perturb → eva
C:auto_tuning.description: Closed-loop parameter optimization: diagnose → perturb → evaluate → adopt. Self-Graph evaluates config choices via COMPONENT_PARAMS. suggest_perturbations generates candidates. auto_tune() runs trial matrix. Parameter sensitivity analysis feeds back into Self-Graph quality signals. Validated by C150-C155 (25 tests).

C:shared_historization.label: Cooperative knowledge sharing via shared Historization insta
C:shared_historization.description: Cooperative knowledge sharing via shared Historization instance across agents. Same topology, same U/F traces. River City: +128-244% cooperative gain vs independent historization. Gordian Trap GT-1 resolution: competition → cooperation. Validated by C189 (14 tests).

C:bootstrap_landscape.label: LLM-seeded landscape initialization from structured spec. Bo
C:bootstrap_landscape.description: LLM-seeded landscape initialization from structured spec. Bootstrapper creates navigable landscape from external knowledge (LLM, files, existing domains). bootstrap.json → 41 nodes, 78 edges as navigable E₀ landscape. Transition potential T(e) drives goal-free exploration. Validated by C44 (bootstrapper), C195-C199 (bootstrap landscape, 51 tests).

C:perception_ontology.label: Gestalt primitives (figure-ground, proximity, closure, simil
C:perception_ontology.description: Gestalt primitives (figure-ground, proximity, closure, similarity, continuity) as learnable perception domain. Observation tells WHAT to look at; perception tells HOW to interpret what is seen. Domain-invariant visual attention model. Validated by C158 (48 tests).

C:communication_intent.label: Intent detection from controller state + perception → UISpec
C:communication_intent.description: Intent detection from controller state + perception → UISpec → human feedback → learning cycle. Closes the human-in-the-loop: E₀ expresses what it needs, human responds, response is historized. Task-aware: landscape + trace data flows into UI generation. Validated by C159-C166b (147 tests).

C:compatibility_gating.label: dream_compatibility threshold (0.6 calibrated, gap=0.410). C
C:compatibility_gating.description: dream_compatibility threshold (0.6 calibrated, gap=0.410). Compatible domains share structural patterns; incompatible domains are gated from dream coupling. Prevents noise injection from structurally alien domains. NOT transitive: A~B and B~C does not imply A~C. Validated by C168-C169 (15 tests).

C:wl_node_fingerprint.label: WL recursive neighborhood fingerprint (depth-2) + Hungarian
C:wl_node_fingerprint.description: WL recursive neighborhood fingerprint (depth-2) + Hungarian optimal assignment for node equivalence. Domain-agnostic structural matching at node level. BT-1 breakthrough: matching strategy (Hungarian) matters more than features. 44/44 = 100% accuracy. Validated by C135-C137.

C:curriculum_navigator.label: Hierarchical learning across derivation levels. Equilibrium
C:curriculum_navigator.description: Hierarchical learning across derivation levels. Equilibrium detection → advance curriculum level. Scoped sub-landscapes for each stage. Historization transfer between curriculum stages preserves learned structure. Macro-orchestration of sleep-wake learning rhythm. Validated by C123, C156 (14 tests).

C:n_domain_mesh.label: N>2 domain coupling with cluster formation and saturation de
C:n_domain_mesh.description: N>2 domain coupling with cluster formation and saturation detection. Quality stabilizes at N≈7, per-domain cost decreases with mesh size. ONTO acts as bridge domain between incompatible clusters (dream transitivity). Saturation point: adding domains beyond capacity degrades quality. Validated by C179-C182 (101 tests).

C:canon_bootstrap_multiverse.label: Unified navigation across theory (Canon: 51 nodes) and pract
C:canon_bootstrap_multiverse.description: Unified navigation across theory (Canon: 51 nodes) and practice (Bootstrap: 41 nodes). Semantic bridges connect what E₀ IS (Ontodynamics) with what E₀ DOES (project memory). 80% crossing rate: exploration oscillates between domains. Cross-domain interference signal. Validated by C200 (19 tests).

B:GT-1.label: Isolated Agents Trap
B:GT-1.description: When agents share a domain, check first: do they share knowledge? Multiverse infrastructure (C60-68) exists for exactly this.
B:GT-1.lesson: When agents share a domain, check first: do they share knowledge? Multiverse infrastructure (C60-68) exists for exactly this.

B:GT-2.label: Blind Trust Trap
B:GT-2.description: Any signal E₀ relies on can be poisoned. Always ask: what if this signal lies? Applies to ALL boundaries — including API responses.
B:GT-2.lesson: Any signal E₀ relies on can be poisoned. Always ask: what if this signal lies? Applies to ALL boundaries — including API responses.
B:GT-2.resolution: C173 structural skepticism (partial), C174 self-honesty (partial). C243b: finish_reason check + LLMTruncatedError + diagnostics logging.

B:GT-3.label: Greedy Matching Trap
B:GT-3.description: When incremental improvements stall, the bottleneck may not be where you think. Step back and question the pipeline.
B:GT-3.lesson: When incremental improvements stall, the bottleneck may not be where you think. Step back and question the pipeline.
B:GT-3.resolution: C137: Hungarian optimal assignment → 44/44 immediately. C243b: checked upstream → max_tokens was the real bottleneck.

B:GT-4.label: Distance Collapse Trap
B:GT-4.description: Self-modifying systems can destroy their own discrimination signal. Monitor signal quality, not just accuracy.
B:GT-4.lesson: Self-modifying systems can destroy their own discrimination signal. Monitor signal quality, not just accuracy.
B:GT-4.resolution: Level-3 neighborhood consistency (C128) gates promotion by structural context.

B:GT-5.label: Amplitude Override Trap
B:GT-5.description: A mechanism that helps in one domain (dead-end traps) can HURT in another (loop traps). Integration value is domain-dependent. Self-reflection (self-graph) is required for the system to detect its own harmful patterns.
B:GT-5.lesson: A mechanism that helps in one domain (dead-end traps) can HURT in another (loop traps). Integration value is domain-dependent. Self-reflection (self-graph) is required for the system to detect its own harmful patterns.
B:GT-5.resolution: C193: Two-layer defense. (1) Revisit-aware override gate: amplitude cannot override to _recent states when self-graph is present — prevents Historization corruption. (2) Self-graph override self-loop: amplitude→amplitude edge accumulates U/F on override events, providing learned long-term quality signal. Gate: override_quality < 0 → block. Self-graph is the trigger: without self-reflection, GT-5 persists by design.

B:GT-6.label: Default Blast Radius Trap
B:GT-6.description: New features default OFF, entry points opt IN. When fixing a break causes >10 edits to unrelated code, stop and question the default.
B:GT-6.lesson: New features default OFF, entry points opt IN. When fixing a break causes >10 edits to unrelated code, stop and question the default.
B:GT-6.resolution: C225 amend: auto_detect=False default, True only in run_interactive() and run_server(). Zero test changes needed.

B:BT-1.label: Feature engineering is NOT the bottleneck — matching strateg
B:BT-1.description: Feature engineering is NOT the bottleneck — matching strategy is. Global optimal assignment avoids cascading errors from greedy matching.

B:BT-2.label: Cooperation effect SCALES with congestion. Shared knowledge
B:BT-2.description: Cooperation effect SCALES with congestion. Shared knowledge prevents problems before they happen. coop+adapt = plain coop (shared hist already prevents surprises).

B:BT-3.label: F=0 traps the system forever — greedy never escapes (proved
B:BT-3.description: F=0 traps the system forever — greedy never escapes (proved with 10k steps). Zweifel zuzulassen (allowing doubt) is structurally necessary, not a flaw.

B:BT-4.label: Integration value is trap-type dependent. Dead-end traps: am
B:BT-4.description: Integration value is trap-type dependent. Dead-end traps: amplitude provides 2x improvement. Loop traps: amplitude HURTS without self-reflection. Self-graph enables self-correction. No single layer dominates all domains.

B:WP-4.description: Quality over Quantity — few high-confidence interventions beat many low-confidence ones

B:WP-6.description: Self-modifying systems can destroy their own signal — monitor signal quality

B:WP-7.description: Zweifel zuzulassen — doubt (F>0) is structurally necessary, not a flaw

B:PC-8.description: Am I hedging or deciding? If >2 caveats — cut to 1 and commit to a position.

EN:relation.label: Abstract concept of connection between things
EN:relation.description: Abstract concept of connection between things

M:historization_engine.label: Records success/failure traces on every traversed edge (U/F)
M:historization_engine.description: Records success/failure traces on every traversed edge (U/F). Asymmetric decay rates (λ_s, λ_f). Computes trace_quality q=(U−F)/(U+F+ε) and trace_load m=U+F. Every other mechanism reads from or writes to historization.

M:greedy_navigation.label: Core decision loop: enumerate admissible edges, compute pena
M:greedy_navigation.description: Core decision loop: enumerate admissible edges, compute penalized tension S_eff=Δ·R_eff/(M_H·I), select minimum. Deterministic, local, operates on a single landscape. Falls back to escalation when no admissible edge exists.

M:amplitude_overlay.label: Sums path amplitudes Ψ(p)=e^{-S(p)}·e^{iΘ(p)} over bounded-h
M:amplitude_overlay.description: Sums path amplitudes Ψ(p)=e^{-S(p)}·e^{iΘ(p)} over bounded-horizon continuations. Computes intensity I∝|Ψ|² per action. Analysis-only layer — provides alternative ranking (Born sampling) without modifying controller state.

M:escalation.label: Detects four frontier types: DEAD_END (no edges), FILTERED (
M:escalation.description: Detects four frontier types: DEAD_END (no edges), FILTERED (all filtered by historization), EXHAUSTED (max steps), OVERLOADED (OI > threshold). Routes to edge proposal, amplitude boost, or peer consultation depending on frontier type.

M:overlap_modulation.label: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))). Greedy divides S_
M:overlap_modulation.description: M_H(x→y) = max(0.2, Σ_z √(v(x,z)·v(z,y))). Greedy divides S_eff by M_H. Rewards well-connected paths. Validated empirically: modulation never harms across 14 domains.

M:inertia_modulation.label: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|). Penalizes confused edges (|q
M:inertia_modulation.description: I(e) = 1 − α·(m/(m+μ))·(1−|q|). Penalizes confused edges (|q|≈0 with high load), rewards edges with clear signal. Divides S_eff to steer navigation away from indecisive territory.

M:reflexive_edge_proposal.label: When stuck at a frontier: extracts Δ/R₀ patterns from succes
M:reflexive_edge_proposal.description: When stuck at a frontier: extracts Δ/R₀ patterns from successful edges, proposes hypothesis edges with confidence-scaled parameters. Stufe 1 (reactive: only on stuck) and Stufe 2 (proactive: anticipates frontiers). Proposed edges persist only if execution succeeds.

M:self_graph.label: Treats E₀'s own operational cycle (amplitude→born→realizatio
M:self_graph.description: Treats E₀'s own operational cycle (amplitude→born→realization→historization→inertia→transition_field) as a navigable landscape. After each step, records which components participated and the outcome. Reveals which components are effective (high |q|) vs confused (q≈0).

M:dual_reflection.label: Harvests self-graph to diagnose component health: healthy, c
M:dual_reflection.description: Harvests self-graph to diagnose component health: healthy, confused, harmful, or inactive. Recommends deactivation of modulation components (curvature, overlap) when they show persistently negative quality despite sufficient trace load.

M:auto_tuning.label: Closed-loop parameter optimization: diagnose (self-graph) →
M:auto_tuning.description: Closed-loop parameter optimization: diagnose (self-graph) → perturb (suggest_perturbations) → evaluate (trial matrix) → adopt (apply_config). Uses COMPONENT_PARAMS to scope which parameters each component controls.

M:multiverse.label: Orchestrates N≥2 coupled E₀ systems with independent landsca
M:multiverse.description: Orchestrates N≥2 coupled E₀ systems with independent landscapes. NoveltyGate: convergence without structural novelty = FAILURE (R_eff rises). Prevents consensus-induced stagnation. Implements Coupling Theorem: closed system cannot escape traps.

M:coupling_router.label: Dynamic partner selection for N>2 universes. RECOVERY mode:
M:coupling_router.description: Dynamic partner selection for N>2 universes. RECOVERY mode: argmax trace_quality (best partner). EXPLORATION mode: argmax Δ (most different partner). Self-historizing coupling quality via CouplingSelfGraph.

M:cross_reflexion.label: When Universe A is stuck, Universe B's experience informs hy
M:cross_reflexion.description: When Universe A is stuck, Universe B's experience informs hypothesis edges in A. Extracts Δ/R₀ medians from donor, generates new edges with coupling_discount (0.5). Scoped variant uses donor-side locality for targeted proposals.

M:dream_mode.label: Passive cross-domain pattern recognition. Computes edge fing
M:dream_mode.description: Passive cross-domain pattern recognition. Computes edge fingerprints f(e)=(q,m,I), finds functional equivalences via Hungarian matching + WL recursive neighborhoods. Never mutates any domain. Feeds bridge hypotheses to cross-reflexion.

M:structural_entropy.label: Two-type forgetting: (1) Non-inscription when outcome matche
M:structural_entropy.description: Two-type forgetting: (1) Non-inscription when outcome matches prediction (novelty < threshold). (2) Structural decay: low-anchor edges removed when dormant > τ. Prevents unbounded landscape growth and noise accumulation.

M:sleep_wake_cycle.label: Parameter-free oscillator: wake (navigate, build experience,
M:sleep_wake_cycle.description: Parameter-free oscillator: wake (navigate, build experience, T_s rises) → check dream_pressure=T_s/(T_s+μ) → sleep (dream_cycle consolidation + structural decay, T_s drops) → wake. Self-sustaining limit cycle.

M:perception_ontology.label: Models human perception as learnable landscape: 10 visual +
M:perception_ontology.description: Models human perception as learnable landscape: 10 visual + 5 language + 7 rendering primitives. Edges encode natural support (emphasis→contrast). Historization reveals which presentation strategies work. Perception tells HOW to interpret; observation tells WHAT to look at.

M:communication_intent.label: Detects 6 intent types from controller state: uncertainty (c
M:communication_intent.description: Detects 6 intent types from controller state: uncertainty (confused component), decision (transition chosen), pattern (trace growth), request (blocked), status (summary), anomaly (unexpected equivalence). Each intent carries urgency, subject, evidence.

M:observation_landscape.label: Treats information about E₀'s running state as navigable dom
M:observation_landscape.description: Treats information about E₀'s running state as navigable domain. States encode scope (global/local) × depth (topology/field/dynamics/mechanics/interference). Same navigation primitives as any domain — E₀ observes itself the same way it observes anything.

M:curriculum_navigator.label: Decomposes large landscapes into cumulative learning turns u
M:curriculum_navigator.description: Decomposes large landscapes into cumulative learning turns using derivation hierarchy. Detects equilibrium (T_s stable) as turn-completion signal. Transfers historization across turns. Optional dream consolidation between turns for knowledge stabilization.
